# PropAudit.io
> Real-time prop firm trailing drawdown calculator, consistency rule auditor, and risk buffer engine for funded traders.

## What is PropAudit.io?
PropAudit.io provides quantitative risk management tools tailored to retail funded traders trading prop firms such as FTMO, FundedNext, Apex Trader Funding, Topstep, The5ers, and Funding Pips.

## Core Features
- Live Trailing Drawdown Simulator: Computes exact liquidation price and buffer based on intra-trade peak equity or midnight reset balance.
- Maximum Safe Lot Sizing: Calculates position size so traders never risk more than their remaining drawdown buffer.
- 30% Consistency Rule Auditor: Evaluates daily P&L distribution to predict and prevent prop firm payout rejections.
- Firm Specifications Database: Continuously updated rules for 6 major prop firms.
